name: Turkey taco bowl
steps: Brown the ground turkey in the olive oil, breaking it up as it cooks.
Season with a pinch of salt and cumin and cook until no pink remains.
Warm the cooked rice and black beans through.
Spoon the rice into a bowl and top with the turkey and beans.
Scatter over the sweetcorn and sliced avocado.
Finish with a squeeze of lime juice.
